sources.entry: Oka Unarchiver - Archive utility with RAR support, batch extraction, and password-protected archives. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1441507725?pt=119209922&ct=github)

summary.name: Oka Unarchiver
summary.one_liner: Oka Unarchiver is a Mac archive utility for extracting and creating archives, including RAR, with batch extraction and support for password-protected files.
use_cases: Extract RAR archives on a Mac
summary.what_it_does: The listing describes Oka Unarchiver as a Mac app for unzipping and archiving files, with RAR format support, batch decompression of archives, and handling of password-protected archives. It offers one-click extraction and archiving. The page's own text is a support FAQ: it says corrupted downloads cannot be unzipped by any app and should be re-downloaded, and that multi-volume archives may need the volume files added to the app because of Mac App Store permission limits. The page does not give detailed feature specifications.
notable: Supports RAR format and batch decompression
Multi-volume archives need all volume files added to the app due to macOS permissions
caveats: Corrupted downloads cannot be unzipped by any application; re-download is the suggested fix
Multi-volume extraction may require manually granting permission or adding all volume files to the app
